name: @vaur94/agz-memory
description: Project-scoped persistent linked memory MCP server for OpenCode V2

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --format esm --packages external --outfile dist/server.js && bun build src/core.ts --target bun --format esm --packages external --outfile dist/core.js && bun build src/admin/index.ts --target bun --format esm --packages external --outfile dist/admin.js && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin build
scripts.check: bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run types && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin check
scripts.test:restore: bun test test/db/maintenance.test.ts test/db/backup-restore.test.ts test/db/restore-live-writer.test.ts test/db/restore-toctou.test.ts test/db/path-symlink-matrix.test.ts
scripts.prepack: bun run release:verify && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
